issues.detail: The Hebrew has 'Aczib' (אַכְזִיב) twice: 'houses of Aczib' (בָּתֵּי אַכְזִיב) and 'a deception to the kings of Israel' (לְאַכְזָב). The Vietnamese renders 'A-khíp' (Achzib? or Achish?) which is a different name; it should be 'Ach-xíp' or 'Ach-xíp' (Aczib). This changes the place name.

The Hebrew 'לְאַכְזָב' means 'for a deception/for a lie' (a wordplay on Aczib), but the Vietnamese 'sẽ trở thành điều vô ích' ('will become useless') is a paraphrase that loses the specific meaning of 'deception' and the wordplay with the place name Aczib.
